**Turn our existing client base into our biggest growth engine, and kick-start your career in account-based sales!

**As a fulltime Account Development Representative at Relesys, you will play a pivotal role in unlocking the growth potential within our existing client portfolio. Where the Business Development team focuses on opening new doors, you focus on going deeper - identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across our already strong client relationships with brands like Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, Vestas, Specsavers, Joe & the Juice, and many more.

In this role, you will work closely alongside our Account Manager and Client Success Managers, reporting to the Director of Sales based in Copenhagen. Together you will map white space, spot expansion signals, and book qualified meetings for our Account Managers and CSMs to take forward. It is a unique position at the intersection of sales and client relationships - and a powerful stepping stone towards becoming an Account Manager, Account Executive, or Client Success Manager 🚀

This is an exciting and transformative time to join Relesys. In strategic partnership with Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring extensive growth and opportunities along the way. You'll get a unique chance to make a tremendous impact - not just on new business, but on the clients who are already trusting us to power their frontline workforce every single day.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Account-Based Outreach Generate qualified upsell and cross-sell pipeline, and execute structured, targeted outreach to contacts within existing client accounts - across cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. Engage new stakeholders, reactivate dormant contacts, and expand your footprint within each account.

• Expansion Opportunity Identification Map organizational white space and work with internal data and client insights to spot signals of growth potential - new departments, new markets, leadership changes, or product gaps - and translate these into qualified conversations.

• Pipeline Qualification & Meeting Booking Understand the current state of each client relationship, map out decision-makers and influencers, qualify expansion opportunities, and book meetings directly with the relevant Account Manager or CSM - handing off with context and confidence.

• Sales & CS Collaboration Partner with Business Development Consultants, Account Managers, and Client Success Managers to align on account health, priorities, and timing. Share insights from outreach to sharpen targeting and messaging.

• Market & Product Knowledge Become an expert with the Relesys solutions, our value proposition, and how different modules and use cases apply across industries. Stay current on trends in retail & hospitality, and connect it to our product releases and roadmap to articulate ROI to existing clients.

• Sales Discipline Own your activity metrics, pipeline targets, and weekly sales rhythm. Continuously improve outreach quality, conversion rates, and stakeholder mapping.

We invest heavily in training, coaching, and structured development to help you grow.

**Who are you?

**

• 6+ months of experience in outbound sales development, account development, or a client-facing commercial role - B2B SaaS experience is a strong advantage

• Comfortable with proactive outreach including cold calling, and building relationships in an account-based context - you know how to add value from the first conversation

• Strong desire to understand clients deeply: their business, their challenges, and where Relesys can help them grow

• Outstanding communication skills across phone, email, and LinkedIn - you engage stakeholders at multiple levels with confidence and clarity

• Thrive in a fast-paced with a target-driven environment and manage multiple priorities

• Experience from or genuine interest in the retail, hospitality, or frontline workforce industries is a plus - especially if you've worked as a frontline employee yourself

• Experience with MEDDPICC or Command of the Message is an advantage

• Preferred qualifications include a bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written 🇬🇧 and one of the Scandinavian languages.

• Based in or near Copenhagen

**What do we offer?

**

• "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• Career path towards becoming specialist within your field, Account Executive, Account Manager or similar

• Occasional travels to Relesys global offices in line with onboarding, QBRs, Company events etc.

• A collaborative and thriving office-first culture where team spirit and fun are at the heart of everything we do

• Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday

• Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

• Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

• Massage sessions every second Monday

• Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, running club, Tuesday fitness w. professional instructor, Wednesday bathing club, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

**When and where do you start?

**We are looking for a colleague to start **in October 2026!

**We are welcoming applications from candidates based **in or near Copenhagen.

**Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button.

**We can't wait to hear from you!

****Who are we?

**Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app 📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

**Our Culture

**Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

Help Write Our Next Chapter

As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

What Makes You Shine:

You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

We would love to hear from you if you bring:

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Crafting What’s Next, Together

You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

The Impact You Will Make

Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

**_Do you enjoy designing highly available network solutions where BGP failover happens seamlessly and downtime is measured in milliseconds? Are you motivated by ownership, technical excellence, and continuous development? If so, Netcompany is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to help drive and evolve our data center and enterprise network infrastructure.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will join our Network Team, which is part of the broader Infrastructure organization. We deliver secure and reliable solutions within our private cloud environments, supporting critical systems for both public and private sector customers.

You will be working with the operation, maintenance, and evolution of Netcompany’s data center and enterprise network infrastructure. You will work on complex, business-critical initiatives spanning the entire networking domain, with opportunities tailored to support your professional growth and career development.

The role offers technical ownership and direct influence on solutions delivered to public-sector and mission-critical customers. In addition, you will work with security as well as automation and DevOps principles within networking, including stabilization and continuous development—from core routing to security and WAN/edge.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Operating, troubleshooting, expanding, and designing network solutions across data center and enterprise/campus environments.

• Enhancing network security through segmentation, policy-based routing (PBR), access control, SIEM and IPS.

• Managing and optimizing Fortinet firewalls, Cisco ASR routers, ACI-switching fabric and related data center technologies.

• Automation/DevOps and Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, templates, pipelines, and code reviews.

• Collaborating closely with specialists across server, storage, and security domains while helping shape the technical direction of the network platform..

**About You

**You are proactive, accountable, and delivery-focused. You take accountability for your work, approach solutions with a structured and analytical mindset, help establish standards and best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of both the team and the platform. In addition, you are comfortable taking the lead and approach challenges in a structured and methodical manner.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or a related field, or possess an equivalent level of qualification.

• Have several years of experience in a similar networking role.

• Have a solid understanding of scripting, automation, and Infrastructure as Code principles.

• Have hands-on experience with firewalls and network security technologies, preferably Fortinet and/or Cisco combined with strong practical experience with enterprise routing/switching, and LAN/WAN environments.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.
